answer: Reaching the mirror of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A nadir of per-task receipts records who did what, and the basalt of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
